name: sol_integrations_chainlink_ccip_7
description: Hardcoded (non-upgradeable) extraArgs in Chainlink CCIP cross-chain messages
question: The source file in `source` constructs a Chainlink CCIP `Client.EVM2AnyMessage` (or similar cross-chain message) whose `extraArgs` field is built from a hardcoded literal gas limit or version tag directly in the message-sending function, with no state variable, setter, or admin-configurable mechanism to update extraArgs after deployment, so the contract cannot adapt to future CCIP gas requirement or protocol version changes without a full redeploy.
criteria: A function builds Client.EVM2AnyMessage with extraArgs: Client._argsToBytes(Client.EVMExtraArgsV1({gasLimit: 200_000})) using a literal constant gasLimit inline in the call
extraArgs bytes are hardcoded as a fixed constant or immutable set only in the constructor with no setter function to change it later
The contract sends CCIP messages using a hardcoded extraArgs value and provides no owner/admin function to update the gas limit or extraArgs version
